basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm a 19-year-old college student from Ontario, Canada, juggling between my studies and my passion for online gaming. I recently discovered Reddit and absolutely love the sense of community here. I'm mostly active during late nights and weekends, when I unwind by trading in Adopt Me and exploring other gaming subreddits. I'm single and currently majoring in Computer Science. I'm still trying to find my way around the platform, so bear with me as I learn the ropes!

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge mainly revolves around gaming, especially simulation and strategy games. I grew up playing games like Animal Crossing and Roblox, which led me to discover communities like AdoptMeTrading. Through self-teaching and engaging with other gamers, I've picked up a lot about in-game trading strategies.
